scope: 13 GDI experiment families; no new training
verification: Read prior experiment audits, compare every exported model parameter to its source, reload safe tensor files, check all archive member hashes.

experiments.input_contract: Frozen MotionBERT pooled feature vectors [N,512] from 243 prepared frames; left/right Ridge output.
experiments.package_scope: One initial frozen-encoder Ridge head and scaler. The encoder itself is not included.

experiments.input_contract: Frozen MotionBERT pooled features [N,512]; baseline or person-weighted Ridge parameters.
experiments.package_scope: Original and weighted Ridge coefficient sets, sharing the original scaler.

experiments.input_contract: 512-dimension frozen features for the named front/middle/last and global/local normalization condition. Each parameter prefix is a different fitted head.
experiments.package_scope: The five fitted validation heads present in new_validation_models.npz; other diagnostic conditions in the result table are not claimed as separately packaged models.

experiments.input_contract: 512-dimension frozen features and the original per-fold scaler/target transform; saved 16-unit residual MLP weights for original versus missing augmentation.
experiments.package_scope: Original models.npz, including the fold scalers/target transforms and 30 residual MLPs across the original three seeds.

experiments.input_contract: Named baseline/valid_pool 512 features, rhythm 10 features, or combined 522 features. Prefix identifies fold and feature contract.
experiments.package_scope: The original 20 Ridge heads (four feature contracts × five folds).

experiments.input_contract: 512-dimension frozen features; checkpoint model.mu/model.scale and output.weight/output.bias. Front/back feature sets were evaluated separately.
experiments.package_scope: Five main head_only refits from the 175-person experiment. Subsequent PLS/diagnostic substudies are grouped in the parent history and are not separate uploads in this batch.

experiments.input_contract: RF accepts the original coordinate, frozen-feature or concatenated summary; temporal CNN accepts [N,512,124] cached time features, with lo/span inverse target transform.
experiments.package_scope: 15 RF refits (three representations × five folds) and five temporal-feature CNN refits. Other controls in the result table are not included as separate checkpoint files.

experiments.input_contract: Original paper-style CNN baseline score plus cached MotionBERT temporal features. Residual weights and matching baseline CNN states are both provided.
experiments.package_scope: Five residual-model refits plus the five matching frozen baseline CNN refits required to interpret the residual scores.

experiments.input_contract: Original model.py combined input: per-side 12-feature 124-frame input and original cached MotionBERT temporal features; buffers include feature normalization.
experiments.package_scope: Five outer refit CNNs. Frozen MotionBERT feature extraction is a prerequisite; its encoder weights are not re-uploaded here.

experiments.input_contract: Per-side 12-feature windows [N,2,124,12]; evaluate every retained window, aggregate by record, apply the saved training-only linear calibration.
experiments.package_scope: Five original outer refits; inner models and later seed/ensemble experiments are not silently combined into this result.

experiments.input_contract: One per-side 12-feature window [N,2,124,12]; lo/span invert targets and calibration=[slope,intercept] returns reported GDI units.
experiments.package_scope: Five original outer refits, recovered as the matching frozen-baseline states used by the verified residual study.

experiments.input_contract: Same per-side 124-frame windows and record membership as source; record_mean and window_control each have five refit models and saved calibration.
experiments.package_scope: Both original arms, window_control and record_mean, with five outer refits each.

experiments.input_contract: Original 7 derived CNN/STT score-and-spread features [N,7] plus base score [N]. Outputs are 17 probabilities at 10-point edges 0..150, not clinical grades.
experiments.package_scope: 20 outer/inner experts, each retaining fitted heads, selected family, temperature and residual comparator parameters. Individual fitting/calibration membership and cached labels are omitted.
